summary: PowerShell scripts are excellent (defensive validation, error handling, modular psm1/ps1 separation). Workflow well-structured (proper triggers, permissions, job dependencies, pwsh shell). Brittleness: hardcoded fixture paths (./Tests/fixtures/mixed-secrets.json) and expected counts (2 expired, 3 warning, 1 ok, lines 39-43) prevent parameterization for additional test scenarios. No env-var/input injection for test flexibility. Minus points for maintenance burden if fixtures/assertions change.
